source: 24/7 Brain research cycle — WebSearch NBA prediction techniques 2025-2026
title: NBA Prediction Improvement: Market Integration + Venn-Abers Calibration

findings.description: A 2025 MDPI study shows that fusing closing moneyline implied probabilities with model predictions yields the strongest performance. The fused model improves upon both non-market and market-only components. Isotonic regression calibration of bookmaker implied probs as a separate 'market model' feature.
findings.citation: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting, MDPI Information 2025
findings.applicability: HIGH — add closing line implied probability as a feature to engine.py Cat43+
findings.implementation: Add market_implied_prob feature from nba-daily-odds.py closing lines

findings.technique: Venn-Abers Calibration (already in PA, port to NBA)
findings.description: Empirical study on 22 datasets: Venn-Abers outperforms both Platt scaling and isotonic regression. Two-regression approach (one per class) reduces overfitting. Already used in PA4 (xgboost_brier with venn_abers calibration getting Brier 0.25). Should be tested on NBA islands.
findings.applicability: MEDIUM — political_alpha PA4 already uses venn_abers successfully
findings.implementation: Add venn_abers to calibration options in NBA hf-space/app.py CALIBRATION_METHODS

findings.description: Research shows home_next, team_elo_5y, team_elo are top-3 SHAP features. XGBoost+SHAP models achieve best Brier 0.221 in recent papers. Use SHAP importance to bias GA feature selection probability toward historically predictive features.
findings.applicability: MEDIUM — requires SHAP installed on HF Spaces (CPU OK)
findings.implementation: In GA mutate(): weight feature selection probability by historical SHAP importance

findings.description: CNN achieves Brier 0.221, MLP 0.225. Stacked ensemble combining neural + tree predictions as meta-features outperforms individual models. CPU spaces can't run CNN but can use MLP as light neural component.
findings.citation: Stacked ensemble NBA, Nature Scientific Reports 2025
findings.applicability: LOW for CPU spaces — skip CNN, but MLP meta-learner feasible
findings.implementation: Add mlp_stacker to model zoo in island app.py (sklearn MLPClassifier, CPU-OK)

findings.technique: Temporal decay weighting of training samples
findings.description: Recent games more predictive than old games. Apply exponential decay weights to training samples: w = exp(-lambda * days_ago). Lambda around 0.002-0.005 (half-life ~140-350 days). Upweights 2025-26 season data.
findings.applicability: HIGH — easy to implement, no extra dependencies
findings.implementation: Add sample_weight to fit() calls in evaluate_individual() using date-based decay

top_recommendation.action: Add closing-line implied probability as feature + temporal decay sample weights
top_recommendation.why: Both are easy to implement, require no new dependencies, and address known weaknesses (market calibration and recency bias)
top_recommendation.effort: LOW — closing line already fetched by nba-daily-odds.py; decay weight is 2 lines in evaluate_individual()

cross_project_port.pa_to_nba: Venn-Abers calibration from PA4 (xgboost_brier) already proven effective — add to NBA calibration options
cross_project_port.nba_to_pa: Temporal decay sample weighting (new, from NBA research) applicable to Political Alpha's 5-day excess return prediction
